public_events.text: The drawing shows a 23 × 64 mm body with four mounting ears, a recessed channel, a through-window, and holes on three faces. I’m checking the end and section views to resolve the channel depths and shallow cross-shaped recess.

arguments.lisp:
(progn
(setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
(setvar "OSMODE" 0)
(setvar "FILEDIA" 0)
(setvar "INSUNITS" 4)
(setvar "MEASUREMENT" 1)
(setvar "DELOBJ" 1)
(setvar "ISOLINES" 6)
(command "_.UCS" "_World")
(defun mkbox (x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1) (command "_.BOX" (list x0 y0 z0) (list x1 y1 z0) (- z1 z0)) (entlast))
(setq blank (mkbox 0.0 0.0 0.0 23.0 64.0 22.1))
(setq blanks (ssadd blank))
(foreach xx '(-10.0 23.0) (foreach yy '(9.0 54.0) (ssadd (mkbox xx yy 1.0 (+ xx 10.0) (+ yy 10.0) 7.0) blanks)))
(command "_.UNION" blanks "")
(setq body (entlast))
(defun boxcut (x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1) (setq cutter (mkbox x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1)) (command "_.SUBTRACT" body "" cutter "") (setq body (entlast)))
(boxcut 5.0 -1.0 16.1 16.5 65.0 23.1)
(boxcut 7.75 17.5 -1.0 13.75 65.0 10.0)
(boxcut 7.75 17.5 9.9 13.75 28.5 23.1)
(boxcut 16.5 29.0 16.1 24.0 34.0 23.1)
(boxcut 9.25 -1.0 -1.0 12.25 1.5 23.1)
(boxcut -1.0 -1.0 7.6 24.0 1.5 10.6)
(command "_.VPOINT" (list -1.0 -1.5 1.2))
(command "_.ZOOM" "_Extents")
(princ (strcat "\nBODY_HANDLE=" (cdr (assoc 5 (entget body)))))
(princ (strcat "\nSOLID_COUNT=" (itoa (sslength (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID") (410 . "Model")))))))
(princ)
)

import numpy as np
import trimesh
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
m=trimesh.load_mesh('stage03-preview.stl')
v=m.vertices-m.bounds.mean(axis=0)
sharp=m.face_adjacency_edges[m.face_adjacency_angles>np.deg2rad(15)]
def render(kind,size=(950,1050)):
 w,h=size
 if kind=='front':
  n=np.array([0.,0.,1.]);r=np.array([1.,0.,0.]);u=np.array([0.,-1.,0.])
 elif kind=='end':
  n=np.array([0.,-1.,0.]);r=np.array([1.,0.,0.]);u=np.array([0.,0.,-1.])
 else:
  n=np.array([.35,.70,.72 if kind=='iso' else -.72]);n/=np.linalg.norm(n)
  r=np.array([n[1],-n[0],0.]);r/=np.linalg.norm(r)
  u=np.cross(r,n)
 p=np.column_stack([v@r,v@u,v@n])
 scale=min((w-100)/np.ptp(p[:,0]),(h-140)/np.ptp(p[:,1]))
 p[:,0]=p[:,0]*scale+w/2;p[:,1]=-p[:,1]*scale+h/2+10
 zbuf=np.full((h,w),-np.inf);out=np.full((h,w,3),255,dtype=np.uint8)
 light=n+u*.55-r*.25;light/=np.linalg.norm(light)
 shade=.55+.40*np.maximum(0,m.face_normals@light)
 for fi,inds in enumerate(m.faces):
  q=p[inds]; xmin=max(0,int(np.floor(q[:,0].min())));xmax=min(w-1,int(np.ceil(q[:,0].max())))
  ymin=max(0,int(np.floor(q[:,1].min())));ymax=min(h-1,int(np.ceil(q[:,1].max())))
  if xmin>xmax or ymin>ymax:continue
  x,y=np.meshgrid(np.arange(xmin,xmax+1)+.5,np.arange(ymin,ymax+1)+.5)
  a,b,c=q;den=(b[1]-c[1])*(a[0]-c[0])+(c[0]-b[0])*(a[1]-c[1])
  if abs(den)<1e-9:continue
  aa=((b[1]-c[1])*(x-c[0])+(c[0]-b[0])*(y-c[1]))/den
  bb=((c[1]-a[1])*(x-c[0])+(a[0]-c[0])*(y-c[1]))/den
  cc=1-aa-bb;z=aa*a[2]+bb*b[2]+cc*c[2]
  zb=zbuf[ymin:ymax+1,xmin:xmax+1]
  mask=(aa>=-1e-8)&(bb>=-1e-8)&(cc>=-1e-8)&(z>zb)
  zb[mask]=z[mask]
  out[ymin:ymax+1,xmin:xmax+1][mask]=(np.array([210,222,237])*shade[fi]).astype(np.uint8)
 for edge in sharp:
  a,b=p[edge];num=max(2,int(np.linalg.norm(b[:2]-a[:2])*2));t=np.linspace(0,1,num)
  q=a[None,:]+(b-a)[None,:]*t[:,None]
  for ox,oy in [(0,0),(1,0),(0,1)]:
   xx=np.floor(q[:,0]).astype(int)+ox;yy=np.floor(q[:,1]).astype(int)+oy
   good=(xx>=0)&(xx<w)&(yy>=0)&(yy<h)
   xx=xx[good];yy=yy[good];zz=q[good,2]
   vis=zz>=zbuf[yy,xx]-.075
   out[yy[vis],xx[vis]]=[46,54,64]
 return Image.fromarray(out)
canvas=Image.new('RGB',(1900,2100),'white')
for i,(kind,label) in enumerate([('iso','Front / right'),('rear','Rear channel'),('end','End recess'),('front','Front view')]):
 im=render(kind);ImageDraw.Draw(im).text((35,25),label,fill=(30,30,30),font_size=27)
 canvas.paste(im,((i%2)*950,(i//2)*1050))
canvas.save('stage03-visual-check.png')
print('Saved rasterized visual check.')
'@ | python -"
